Callout.Name: Kidnap - Recovery Operation
Callout.Message: Person taken from a street and believed held locally.
Callout.Advisory: One vehicle involved, direction of travel known.

Script.Line: The passenger asked for a lift. That is all.
Nobody is being held anywhere. Turn round and look for yourself.
You are not opening that door from the outside.

Lines.Approach: The car went east and there is somebody in the back of it. This is a recovery, not a chase.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
